build_VJEPA2_model: build a VJEPA2 pydantic model to extract video features using the facebook vjepa2 vitg transformer
run_VJEPA2_call: run the VJEPA2 model on video events to extract latent feature tensors at a given start and duration
create_VideoModel_predict: create a VideoModel instance and call predict on a numpy array of images to get model predictions
test_VideoModel_hidden_states: test the VideoModel predict_hidden_states method to return concatenated hidden state tensors from all transformer layers
refactor_VJEPA2_aggregate_layers: refactor the VJEPA2 _aggregate_layers method to support custom layer aggregation strategies beyond group_mean
